workshop.title: Craft workshop

workshop.clay.name: Pinch clay
workshop.clay.desc: Shape a 3D model with your finger and put a photo on it
workshop.gallery.name: Gallery

beads.title: Perler beads
beads.sub: Pick a photo and we lay it out bead by bead. You see the pattern straight away; 5 points unlocks the full pattern and the list of beads to buy.
beads.signin: Sign in to make bead patterns.
beads.tip: Photos with a clear subject and few colours come out best: a lantern, a building against the sky, a face.
beads.locked: Preview · unlock for the full pattern
beads.dither: Blend colours for photos (softer, more beads to sort)
beads.facts: {w} × {h} beads · about {cmw} × {cmh} cm once ironed · {boards} pegboards · {colours} colours · {beads} beads
beads.unlock.note: Unlocking the same pattern again is free.
beads.unlock.title: Bead pattern and materials list
beads.order.title: Kit by post
beads.kit.FULL_KIT.desc: Beads, square pegboards, ironing paper and tweezers
beads.kit.BEADS.desc: For when you already have boards and an iron
beads.order.demo: Payment is a demonstration: the order is recorded and no money is taken. Our team reads the address only to pack the kit.
beads.order.demoCheck: I understand no money is taken for this demonstration order
beads.order.done: Order placed. We will pack the kit.
clay.title: Pinch clay
clay.signin: Sign in to keep your clay pieces.
clay.start.sub: Start from a lump, then press, pull and smooth it like real clay. Nothing here costs points.
clay.template.tile.desc: Best for a photo on the front
clay.template.cup.desc: Turns on the wheel as you shape it
clay.template.hut.desc: A street corner you walked past
clay.ai.title: Start from a photo with AI
clay.ai.sub: Send one photo: AI lays it out as a colourful clay figure in about half a minute, then you pinch it into shape. {n} points, returned if it fails.
clay.ai.off: Photo to 3D is not switched on yet. No points are taken.
clay.ai.local: Photo to 3D needs a signed-in account; the local experience cannot use it.
clay.ai.confirm.detail: The photo goes to the AI model. Points come back if nothing is made.
clay.ai.failed.refunded: No model was made. {n} points returned.
clay.stage.alt: Clay. Drag on the clay to shape it, drag beside it to turn, pinch to zoom.
clay.help: One finger on the clay shapes it. One finger beside it turns the table. Two fingers zoom and move.
clay.photo.title: Put a photo on it
clay.photo.sub: Turn the clay to face the way the photo should land, then choose a photo. A cup can have it wrapped all round.
clay.name: Name
clay.credit: Clay engine from PINCH by our team. GLB keeps the photo; STL is for 3D printing.
clay.webgl: This phone cannot show 3D here. Your piece is saved and can still be exported.
clay.webgl.lost: The 3D view paused while the phone was busy. It comes back on its own; if not, go back and open the piece again. Your work is saved.
clay.notfound: This clay piece is not on this phone.
clay.model.invalid: This 3D file could not be opened.
clay.model.compressed: This 3D file is compressed in a way the bench cannot read.

gallery.noRemix: The maker has not allowed remixes.

gallery.remix.title: After {title}

workshop.desk.title: My workshop
gallery.example.ex_panda.story: Black-and-white glaze, a green stalk to chew. Pinch the ears bigger, or give it a hat.
gallery.example.ex_lantern.story: A Fuzimiao lantern with gold ribs and a tassel. Cut the light-hole bigger and hang it up.
gallery.example.ex_pagoda.story: Jade-green roofs stacked over cream walls, a gold spire on top.
gallery.example.ex_bao.story: Three buns in a bamboo steamer, one with a red dot for luck.
gallery.example.ex_bubbletea.story: Caramel tea, a yellow band, a pink straw and pearls you can count.
gallery.example.ex_ferry.story: Blue hull, red roof, round windows: the boat across the river at dusk.
gallery.example.ex_beads_panda.story: 16 × 16 pegs, three colours: a good first bead picture.
gallery.example.ex_beads_lantern.story: Red and gold with an orange tassel. Hangs nicely on a bag.
gallery.example.ex_beads_dumpling.story: A smiling bun on a bamboo steamer.
gallery.example.ex_beads_skyline.story: The Pearl Tower and its neighbours over the river, 24 × 22 pegs.
